correctness.rationale: All 3461 simplices and full boundary matrices are reconstructed. Rank_F2 is a lower bound for rank_Q; chain-square rank constraints force rational ranks 20,148,496,722,312,24 exactly, leaving H4 of dimension 16 alone. All 336 automorphisms are exhausted and signed-simplex Lefschetz traces equal independently counted cycle-orbit traces. Eight Sylow-7 subgroups are enumerated; the three character inner products form I3, proving the 1+7+8 Q-module via Maschke. Complete replay of actual embedded verifier returns VERIFY_OK. No integral splitting or independent review claimed.

value.rationale: The Fano plane incidence graph is a canonical maximally symmetric 14-vertex cubic graph. Beyond the previously known Betti number 16, the finding computes traces for every automorphism, proves invariant dimension 1, geometrically identifies the seven-dimensional Sylow-seven constituent, and establishes a new irreducible eight-dimensional complement. Determining the module is neither a generic homology dimension substitution nor an arbitrary numeric invariant; it is motivated by the natural full symmetry action.
